name: keys-bpm-family
about: The bpm key and clear, stopped, starting at 120 bpm. Nothing fires and nothing plays, so the trace is empty and the harness's frames stay true to mbpm while the engine's tempo moves. A clean press and release of bpm steps the preset: 140, 80, 120. Held, the fields show the volume (all sixteen), slider A shows swing (0) and B the tempo (60 of 180 bpm up: 21845). B to 40000 is 170 bpm and shows as 40049; A to 20000 is swing 15 and shows as 20479; key 8 is volume 8. That hold was used, so letting go does not step the preset. The next hold sends each slider the value it already shows: nothing changes and the hold is not used, so letting go steps 170 to 80, the lowest preset above it being none. Function + pattern clears every step (the field and the stitch go out); swing, tempo and volume stay.
